description: Use this when the user says not to suggest something again: a status page, an alert channel, inviting a teammate, cron monitoring, subdomains or anomaly detection. Returns which suggestion is off. It stays off for this member in every assistant's conversations; the dashboard's own prompts are dismissed on the dashboard. Not for declining once: leaving a suggestion unanswered is enough.

suggestion.description: The suggestion's key, as results give it.

name: dismiss_suggestion
title: Stop a suggestion
